paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Distribution of reference answers and test cases in the dataset. Among the entries, 38.9% have reference answers, 21.9% include test cases, and 39.2% have neither reference answers nor test cases.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of reference answers and test cases within the dataset, divided into three categories: “Null” (39.2%, shown in red), “Have reference answer” (38.9%, shown in blue), and “Have test case” (21.9%, shown in green). The chart visually represents the proportions of entries that have neither reference answers nor test cases (Null), those that have reference answers, and those that have test cases. Each segment is labeled with its category name and corresponding percentage, and the legend in the top-left corner matches the colors to their respective categories, also displaying the raw counts: Null (549,238), Have reference answer (543,935), and Have test case (306,818). The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with the “Null” segment being the largest, followed by “Have reference answer,” and then “Have test case.”
